page.overview:
Who is 10934 Creative Animals?

The set contains 175 pieces, the majority of which are miscellaneous bricks. However, it is possible to build three habitats and nine animals (whale, penguin, panda, toucan, elephant, monkey, giraffe, tiger, crocodile). There is a wide variety of bricks to choose from, including flowers, bricks in various shapes, plates in various shapes, inverted bows, roof tiles, round bricks, plates with round corners, bricks with outside bows, arches, and more in a wide variety of colors, including Aqua, Black, Bright Green, Bright Red, Bright Yellow, Bright Yellowish Green, Dark Azur, Dark Orange, Dark Stone Gray, Flame Yellowish-Orange, Medium Azur, Medium Stone Gray, White, and more.

• As kids build and play with the adorable animal figures in their different habitats, they develop key creative, imaginative and practical skills that will last a lifetime.

• This 175-piece set contains colorful bricks and pieces that build into a monkey, tiger, toucan, panda, elephant, giraffe, crocodile, penguin and whale, plus 3 awesome environments: Arctic, jungle and savanna.

• It's easy for little hands to pick up and place these toddler-friendly pieces. With 9 animals and 3 habitats to build, there’s enjoy endless imaginative fun to enjoy (but look out for the crocodile’s opening mouth!).
